content: ArgoCD sync features: automated sync (auto-apply on new commit), prune (delete removed resources, off by default), self-heal (revert manual drift). Health checks built-in for standard resources, custom Lua checks possible. Rollback: sync failure can auto-revert to last good version, but manual rollback via UI cannot be performed while automated sync is enabled (must disable auto-sync first). Notifications subsystem (argocd-notifications) triggers on sync-succeeded/failed/health-degraded to Slack/Discord/Telegram/webhook. Standard homelab posture: auto-sync + self-heal + prune on, notifications to a chat channel or ntfy.
